title: Apple Silicon wasm build failure (R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_SLEB, -fPIC), unconfirmed
summary: A hackathon project README reports `relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_SLEB cannot be used against symbol ... recompile with -fPIC` on Apple Silicon and works around it with Docker. We did not reproduce it: a pure-Rust contract built and deployed on an arm64 Mac. It is plausibly tied to C dependencies.

steps: Unconfirmed. If you hit this, run `near-doctor submit` with the full error so the cause can be pinned down.

evidence.observed: Not reproduced 2026-11-13: a pure-Rust contract built with cargo near and deployed on macOS 15 arm64.
